claims: The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission carries four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day journey around the Moon.
The Artemis II astronauts are the first humans to travel to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Artemis II crew includes NASA’s Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency’s Jeremy Hansen.
Reid Wiseman (NASA) is the Commander of the Artemis II mission.
Victor Glover (NASA) is the Pilot of the Artemis II mission.
Victor Glover is the first Black man to travel around the Moon.
Christina Koch (NASA) is a Mission Specialist on the Artemis II mission.
Christina Koch is the first woman to travel around the Moon.
Jeremy Hansen (CSA) is a Mission Specialist on the Artemis II mission.
Jeremy Hansen is the first Canadian to travel around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is a crewed test flight to verify Orion spacecraft systems before future lunar landing missions.
